items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: She thought Dr. Howard was alright

ctx.x: That was a birthday present, born the 18th of June, he always remembered it too And he was happy that you hadn't been married, didn't you? I hadn't been married and I was still a young lady, he said, yeah And your sister had been married quite early then?

Oh yeah, my sister married at 15, yeah I didn't marry until six months before I made 18 I mean, and I wanted to go to school, and I really would have gone, but my grandmother had asthma And she always predicted to herself, you know, I'm gonna die next year, and I don't want to leave you here, young lady And she said, school, marriage is an institution as well as you're going to be a career woman You don't know anything about the world, she wanted us to stay home and be married And I did to please her, and I…
Your brother left home, your grandmother didn't get along with him, I think you said, or he said that
